about: Judged attributes for the look navigator's star graph, 0 to 10. Measured attributes (darkness, contrast, colourfulness, warmth, roundness, density) are computed from each look file at load time and are not stored here. A look missing from this file still shows its measured attributes.
scoredBy: Claude (Opus 5.5), from each look's mood, motion signature, forms and 3D lines, plus the demo pages that existed on 2026-10-17

attributes.boldness: How loud it reads: display type weight, accent strength, size of the moves.
attributes.playfulness: How much fun and give it has: toys, bounce, hand-drawn touches.
attributes.formality: How buttoned-up it feels: fit for an executive or an engineering doc.
attributes.motion: How much moves, from its motion signature: count and size of the moments.

why.boldness: a big upright serif and a glowing aurora, kept airy
why.playfulness: spring cursor blob and scramble text add some fun
why.formality: editorial serif voice for launches and narrative reports
why.motion: six moving moments: aurora, cursor blob, scramble, parallax, toasts, diagonal wipe

why.boldness: filmic dark ground, ember accent, full-screen pinned scenes
why.motion: everything is scroll-driven: pinned scenes, scrubbed reveals, exploded stack, radial sweep

why.boldness: standard cards and a cyan accent on navy, nothing shouts
why.formality: left rail and collapsible sections, a working report
why.motion: only entrance staggers and number tweens

why.formality: a sober report and status-page look
why.motion: the report load choreography and calm scroll reveals
